result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly. The main visual defect is a loading spinner left visible on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, suggesting a stuck or unfinished image-loading state.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the image behind it appears fully loaded, indicating a stuck or orphaned loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner overlay is removed once the image finishes loading (e.g., hide the loader on the image's onLoad event, and add a timeout/fallback so the spinner never persists indefinitely).

issues.description: The green promo banner's decorative circles are abruptly clipped at the banner's right edge, creating hard cut lines within the card.
issues.suggestion: Apply overflow clipping with matching rounded corners or reposition the decorative shapes so they blend smoothly instead of ending in sharp straight edges.
